chunks: And neither stand up nor defend themselves.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when disbelievers cannot stand or defend themselves on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the total impotence of the disbelievers on the Day of Judgment, where their accumulated power and efforts become utterly futile against divine decree. It serves as a profound reminder that worldly strength is transient, and ultimate victory belongs solely to those who align with God's will, reinforcing the concept of divine justice (Adl).
